name: Jev Chat Assistant Keyboard for iOS
description: iOS custom-keyboard chat copilot: copy a message in any chat app, tap Analyze on the Jev keyboard, and it calls TypeSafe Jev (systemone) for an 8-way intent Choice and a 0-9 risk Score, drafts two replies per tone (12 built-in tones) via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, re-ranks them with Jev, and inserts the pick into the input box — never sends.
